headlines.title: 11월 개인 투자용 국채 2천억원 발행 예정
headlines.summary: 다음 달 11∼17일 청약기간 국고채 (PG) [강민지 제작] 일러스트 (세종=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 재정경제부는 다음 달 개인 투자용 국채를 총 2천억원 발행할 예정이라고 29일 밝혔다. 종목별로는 3년물 이표채 20억원, 3년물 복리채 30억원을 발행하고, 5년물은 200억원, 10년물은 1천400억원, 20년물은 350억원을 발행할 계획이다.

headlines.title: 퇴직금 체불 ' 원천차단 '… 노후소득보장·수익률 제고 시험대
headlines.summary: 2030년까지 전 사업장 의무화 전문법인 일임 '기금형' 신설 '자동 연금지급'으로 노후 보장 정부가 발표한 퇴직연금 개편안은 2005년 제도 도입 이후 20여년 만의 구조 개편이다. 체불 방지에 머물던 퇴직급여 제도를 전문 운용을 통한 수익률 제고와 노후소득 보장까지 아우르는 체계로 바꾸겠다는 구상이다.

headlines.title: 경영계 “ 중소·영세기업 여건 충분히 고려해야 ”
headlines.summary: 경총, 정부 퇴직연금 기능강화 방안에 입장문 노후소득보장 취지 공감, 중소기업 고려해야 기금형 퇴직연금, 손실 대비한 보호장치 필요 경영계가 정부의 퇴직급여 사외적립 의무화 방침에 대해 근로자의 노후소득 보장이라는 취지에는 공감하면서도 중소·영세기업의 부담을 고려한 제도 시행의 필요성을 강조했다.

headlines.summary: ■ 정부, 8·13 대책 후속조치 모두 서울 경계서 5㎞ 이내 지역 기존발표지 합쳐 총 10.4만 가구 정부가 ‘주택 신속 공급방안’후속 조치로 추가 신규택지를 발표한 가운데 3.7만호가 공급될 경기 김포 고촌읍 부지 모습.

headlines.title: 7.7만호 실입주 까지 빨라야 10년 안팎 …집값 안정 '속도전'에 달렸다
headlines.summary: 서울 경계 5㎞ 경기 6곳 선정 기존 신도시·철도망 활용해 속도전 서울 강남권 그린벨트 해제는 무산 실제 입주는 2030년대 중반 전망 29일 국토교통부가 발표한 수도권 신규택지 후보지 6곳(7만6700가구)은 모두 서울 경계에서 5㎞ 안에 있는 수도권 개발제한구역(그린벨트)에 자리 잡았다.

headlines.title: ‘ 강남아파트 거래절벽 오자 ’… 집값 소폭 하락·전세는 상승

headlines.title: 원화 강세에 달러대출 급증 … 연중 최고치

top5_headlines.summary: 10년물 1400억·20년물 350억원 발행 20년물 만기 보유 시 세전 수익률 162.6% 전용계좌·퇴직연금계좌 통해 청약 가능 [서울=뉴시스] [세종=뉴시스]여동준 기자 = 재정경제부가 다음 달 개인투자용 국채를 총 2000억원 규모로 발행한다. 재경부는 29일 이 같은 내용의 '11월 개인투자용 국채 발행계획'을 발표했다.

top5_headlines.summary: 한국은행, 2026년 10월 기업경기조사 결과 전산업 기업심리지수(CBSI) 104.2, 4년 2개월만에 최고치…5년 6개월만에 최대 상승폭 제조업 CBSI 105.6, 4년 4개월만에 최고치…역시 5년 6개월만에 최대 상승 중소기업·내수기업으로 반도체 온기 확산…6년 만에 최대 상승 비제조업 cbsi 103.

top5_headlines.summary: 10월 전산업 기업심리지수(CBSI) 4년 2개월만에 최고 중소기업 심리 개선폭 대기업 수출기업 앞질러 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관 (재정경제부 제공. 재판매 및 DB 금지) 2026.10.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Transaction Cliff: Prices Fall 2.5% While Jeonse Deposits Rise 3.8%
key_headlines.summary: Seoul's 84-square-meter apartments saw a 2.5% price decline, but jeonse (long-term lease) deposits surged 3.8% in a year. Government housing supply measures are insufficient to resolve the housing supply shortage and market instability.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Eyes Post-Semiconductor Growth: Eight Strategic Industries to Develop
key_headlines.summary: As semiconductors comprise 49.9% of September exports, the government is diversifying growth engines by promoting eight strategic sectors including shipbuilding and defense. The nation achieved record export performance exceeding one trillion dollars.

key_headlines.title: Corporate Confidence Reaches 4-Year High Amid Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: The composite business survey index (CBSI) hit 103.2 in October, the highest in 4 years and 2 months, with semiconductor warmth spreading to small and medium-sized enterprises. This reflects improving export and investment trends across industries.

key_headlines.title: Samsung Electronics Reports HBM4 Sales Triple; Next Year Supply Nearly Sold Out
key_headlines.summary: Samsung Electronics tripled HBM4 sales in the third quarter and achieved near-complete sellout of next year's HBM supplies due to strong AI infrastructure demand. The company projects next year's performance will surpass this year.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Federal Reserve Holds Rate Steady at 3.75-4.00%; December Increase Anticipated
key_headlines.summary: The Fed maintained interest rates unchanged, citing strong economic activity but persistent inflation concerns. Markets anticipate a rate increase in December, with Korea gaining special attention from Fed Chair Kevin Powell regarding supply chain dynamics.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy demonstrates robust momentum driven by semiconductor and AI sector expansion. Corporate confidence reached a 4-year high with the composite business survey index at 103.2, reflecting broad-based improvements from large exporters to small enterprises. The nation's export performance continues to achieve record levels, surpassing one trillion dollars. However, the real estate market shows mixed signals with apartment prices declining 2.5% while jeonse deposit prices jumped 3.8%, indicating structural supply challenges despite government intervention efforts.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The U.S. Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate steady at 3.75-4.00% in late October, pausing after a September increase. The Fed acknowledged strong economic activity and stable employment but expressed concern about persistent inflation above the 2% target. Market expectations point to a December rate increase, with the Fed reducing annual rate decisions from 8 to 6 meetings starting next year. South Korea's central bank announced its 2027 monetary policy schedule, with the first rate decision scheduled for January 14.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI closed at 6012.44, up 6.63%, maintaining strength above the 6000 level as semiconductor stocks led gains. The KOSDAQ showed slight weakness on the day. Individual investors purchased 322.9 billion won while foreign investors bought 133.3 billion won, though institutions sold net 389 billion won. U.S. markets rose modestly following the Fed's rate hold, with semiconductor stocks performing strongly after SK Hynix reported record quarterly earnings. Interest in dividend stocks increased amid market volatility.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung Electronics tripled HBM4 sales in the third quarter and essentially sold out next year's HBM supply, highlighting semiconductor sector strength driven by AI infrastructure demand. Korea achieved notable technology milestones including developing the nation's first space robotic arm and key semiconductor wafer processing equipment. LG Energy Solution launched the Battery Innovation Contest 2026 to source next-generation battery technologies. Microsoft reported a 19% surge in quarterly revenue to 124 trillion won, driven by cloud and AI division growth.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment supply faces severe constraints with 2026 new apartment units projected at 17,698 households, the lowest in 13 years and 45% below last year's 32,370 households. The market shows divergent signals: apartment transaction prices fell 2.5% while jeonse deposit prices rose 3.8%, reflecting structural supply shortages. New developments include a 23-story forest-view apartment redevelopment project in Huokseok-dong following height regulation changes. Prices in some segments hit new highs, with a 60-square-meter unit in Songpa selling for 1.735 billion won.
sections.International Economy: U.S. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Powell expressed special interest in Korea's economy, noting its critical role in advanced technology supply chains alongside Japan and Singapore. China's Vice Finance Minister Liao Min was nominated as IMF Deputy Managing Director, reflecting his role in U.S.-China trade negotiations. The Fed maintained its 3.75-4.00% rate, as markets anticipate December increases. Korean economic performance, particularly in semiconductor and AI sectors, is attracting heightened international attention.
sections.AI & Economy: Samsung Electronics reported HBM4 sales tripled with nearly complete sellout of next year's supplies driven by robust AI infrastructure demand. Microsoft delivered earnings surprises with 19% quarterly revenue growth led by cloud and AI divisions. AI-related credit concerns emerged as some companies' bond yields reached double digits, though U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Besent downplayed risks, citing the small share of neo-cloud companies in the AI ecosystem. South Korea's government launched initiatives to nurture AI startups into global unicorns while AI-based investment platforms gain recognition.
sections.Others: The government strengthened linkage between science-technology and economic policies through seven SEED projects focusing on nuclear fusion, renewable energy, and advanced biotechnology. The Small Business Ministry began intensive efforts to develop AI startups into global unicorn companies through discovery, growth, and overseas expansion programs. NH Investment Securities won awards for advancing AI and big-data based investment platforms. U.S. computer science enrollment declined 12% at undergraduate levels and 10% at graduate levels, reflecting AI job displacement concerns among students.
